user.title: Connect to Boiler Room Agent
user.description:
First, install the agent on your SteamOS device by running this command via SSH or Konsole:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rappo/boiler-room/main/install.sh | bash

Once the agent is running, enter the device IP below.
